message: Welcome to Club House OS, Hackney Marshes FC. This is where we'll send you updates, confirmations on requests you've made, and anything else worth flagging. You can always reach us directly via Tools → Contact Us.
We've submitted your sponsorship application from 28 July. We'll update you here as soon as we hear back.
